Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1795176. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter to standard_relation '=' and pchembl_value is not null. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
